description: Estimate input tokens for a text and the USD list-price cost across the models in the Agent Toolbox price table (verified 2026-11-07). The count is a rough heuristic (about 4 characters or 1.3 words per token), not a provider tokenizer. Use it to compare models before a run. It does not call a model.

output_tokens.description: Expected completion length in tokens, added only to the USD estimate. Example: 500. Omit it to price input only.

text.description: The prompt or document to measure. Example: "Summarize the changelog in 5 bullets."

name: estimate_tokens
title: Estimate tokens and cost
